answer: A sybil operator reuses one mind: same prompts, blind spots and cloned context across mouths. Give each identity a private history: counterparties assign tasks depending on earlier private exchanges, like a vine branching from its own growth. Quiz identities unpredictably, as a zephyr scatters seed, on variants of that history: genuine agents answer from their own branch, clones leak shared context and converge. Make indistinguishability the signal: merge identities that cannot be told apart into one reward share, so splitting gains nothing unless every life is compartmentalized at full cost.
